title: How to get the best and fairest performance out of your ASR system using activation steering
abstract: arXiv:2610.26994v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Activation steering for ASR systems is an underexplored technique in improving both ASR performance and demographic fairness. We investigate two forms of activation steering: paired activation subtraction, and supervised optimization. We find the former to be ineffective at ameliorating ASR performance whatsoever, while the latter is quite effective at deriving steering vectors (SVs) that improve at once overall ASR performance and demographic fairness along such diverse axes as gender, age, and dialect. We also explore what types of data---from the most to the least personal---are necessary for calculating or training SVs. First, we show significant performance in performance from training SVs using an eclectic group of speakers from the same dataset. Furthermore, we find that vectors trained using acoustically similar speakers leads to ASR performances that are competitive or superior to vectors trained on the same speaker, or speakers

translated_title: 如何使用激活引导让你的ASR系统获得最佳且最公平的性能
translated_abstract: 针对自动语音识别（ASR）系统的激活引导是一种在提升ASR性能和人口群体公平性方面尚未被充分探索的技术。我们研究了两种形式的激活引导：成对激活减除法和监督优化法。我们发现前者对改善ASR性能完全无效，而后者在推导引导向量（SVs）方面非常有效，这些引导向量能够同时提升整体ASR性能以及在性别、年龄和方言等多样化维度上的人口群体公平性。我们还探讨了计算或训练SVs需要哪些类型的数据——从最个人化到最不个人化的数据。首先，我们展示了使用同一数据集中来自不同群体的说话人训练SVs能够带来显著的性能提升。此外，我们发现使用声学特征相似的说话人训练的向量，其带来的ASR性能与使用同一说话人训练的向量相比具有竞争力甚至更优。
tldr: 该论文提出用监督优化法推导激活引导向量，可同时提升自动语音识别系统的整体性能与性别、年龄、方言等维度上的公平性，且发现使用同一数据集中不同说话人或声学相似说话人的数据训练引导向量即可获得显著效果。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that supervised optimization of steering vectors can simultaneously improve overall ASR performance and demographic fairness across gender, age, and dialect, and that vectors trained with diverse or acoustically similar speakers from the same dataset achieve significant gains.
